definition_zh: 任务；工作；使承担艰巨任务
definition_en: a piece of work that must be done, or to give someone a difficult job
core_image: 桌上摊开的清单上划掉一项工作
scene: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。The teacher gave each group a task.
sceneCN: 这里 task 是「任务」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。

senses.title: A piece of work
senses.definition: a piece of work that has to be done
senses.definitionCN: 必须完成的一项工作
senses.example: The teacher gave each group a task.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。
senses.why: The word came from a tax or duty imposed on someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指摊派到某人身上的税或义务。

senses.title: To give someone a job
senses.definition: to give someone a particular job to do
senses.definitionCN: 把某项工作交给某人去完成
senses.example: The manager tasked her with writing the report.
senses.exampleCN: 经理把写报告的任务交给了她。
senses.why: A task is laid on a person, so the verb means laying the duty down.
senses.whyCN: 任务是被「压」到人身上的，因此动词表示把责任派下去。

intro.en: Task came from a word for a tax or duty laid on people.
intro.cn: task 源自表示「摊派的税与义务」的词。

items.en: Tasca meant a tax or duty.
items.cn: tasca 意为税或义务。

items.en: Tasque carried the sense of an imposed duty.
items.cn: tasque 表示被摊派的义务。

items.en: Task meant a piece of required work.
items.cn: task 意为必须完成的工作。

items.en: Task lost the tax sense and kept the work sense.
items.cn: task 舍弃税务义，保留工作义。

items.en: The verb means to assign work.
items.cn: 动词义为分派工作。

note.en: Task is compared with look-alike words and with words for work.
note.cn: 把 task 与形近词以及表示工作的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Task is a duty laid on your desk and waiting to be finished.
normalIntro.cn: task 是放到你桌上、等着被完成的一项义务。

normal.en: The teacher gave each group a task.
normal.cn: 老师给每个小组布置了任务。

normal.en: The manager tasked her with the report.
normal.cn: 经理把报告的任务交给了她。

normal.en: Finishing the list is today task.
normal.cn: 完成清单是今天的任务。

normal.en: A task force was sent to the site.
normal.cn: 一支特别工作组被派往现场。

normal.en: He was taken to task for the delay.
normal.cn: 他因延误受到责备。

abstract.en: A duty becomes a job on a list.
abstract.cn: 义务变成清单上的一项工作。

abstract.en: A task is a promise with a deadline.
abstract.cn: 任务是有期限的承诺。

abstract.en: Work assigned is work that can be finished.
abstract.cn: 被分派的工作，就是可以被完成的工作。

examples.en: The teacher gave each group a task.
examples.cn: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。

examples.en: The manager tasked her with writing the report.
examples.cn: 经理把写报告的任务交给了她。

examples.en: A task force was sent to the site.
examples.cn: 一支特别工作组被派往现场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他斯克」——「他」必须在天黑前「斯克」服这一堆活，就是任务。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 tasca（税、义务）经古法语 tasque 进入英语，由「摊派的义务」转为「任务」。

sensesIntro.en: Task began as an imposed duty and settled into a piece of work and the act of assigning it.
sensesIntro.cn: task 从被摊派的义务，固定为一项工作，以及分派工作的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a duty pinned to a desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份被钉在桌上的义务。

branches.en: The work itself is the main sense.
branches.cn: 工作本身是主要义项。

branches.en: Assigning is laying the duty down.
branches.cn: 分派就是把义务放下。

branches.en: Noun and verb mirror each other.
branches.cn: 名词与动词互为一体两面。

branches.en: A task force is a group for one job.
branches.cn: 特别工作组就是为一项任务而设。

branches.en: Blame also assigns a burden.
branches.cn: 责备同样是在派一份负担。

intro.en: Task extends through compounds and inflection.
intro.cn: task 通过复合词与屈折扩展。

latinIntro.en: Task traces to Medieval Latin tasca, a tax or duty.
latinIntro.cn: task 可追溯到中世纪拉丁语 tasca（税、义务）。

items.exampleCN: 分派工作是管理的一部分。

items.meaning: to do several tasks at once

definition_en: the flavour of food, the ability to judge what is good, or to try food with the tongue
core_image: 舌尖刚碰到一勺热汤
scene: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。She tasted the soup and found it a little salty.
sceneCN: 这里 taste 是「品尝」（第 2 个义项）；句意：她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。

senses.title: The flavour of food
senses.definition: the flavour that food or drink has in the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 食物或饮料在口中呈现的滋味
senses.example: The soup has a strong taste of garlic.
senses.exampleCN: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。
senses.why: The core sense is what the tongue reports about food.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项是舌头对食物作出的报告。

senses.title: To try food
senses.definition: to put food or drink in the mouth to find out its flavour
senses.definitionCN: 把食物或饮料放入口中以辨别滋味
senses.example: She tasted the soup and found it a little salty.
senses.exampleCN: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。
senses.why: The noun became the act of testing flavour.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了检验滋味的动作。

senses.title: Good judgment of style
senses.definition: the ability to judge what is beautiful or suitable
senses.definitionCN: 判断美与得体的能力
senses.example: Her taste in music is very wide.
senses.exampleCN: 她在音乐上的品味很广。
senses.why: Judging flavour by the tongue became judging quality by the mind.
senses.whyCN: 用舌头判断滋味，扩展为用头脑判断品质。

senses.title: A small experience of something
senses.definition: a short experience that shows what something is like
senses.definitionCN: 让人了解某事滋味的短暂经历
senses.example: He had a taste of success at nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十九岁时初尝成功的滋味。
senses.why: A taste is a small sample, and an experience can be sampled too.
senses.whyCN: 品尝本就是取一小口，人生经历也可以「取一小口」。

intro.en: Taste came from a word meaning to touch and test, not only to eat.
intro.cn: taste 源自「触摸、检验」之词，最初并不只与吃有关。

items.en: Taxare meant to touch sharply and judge.
items.cn: taxare 意为触击并评判。

items.en: Taster meant to touch and try.
items.cn: taster 意为触摸并试验。

items.en: Tasten meant to try food in the mouth.
items.cn: tasten 意为在口中试食物。

items.en: Taste extended to judgment of style.
items.cn: taste 扩展到对风格的判断。

items.en: It also means a small experience.
items.cn: 它还表示短暂的体验。

note.en: Taste is compared with look-alike words and with words for flavour and preference.
note.cn: 把 taste 与形近词以及表示滋味和偏好的词作对比。

entries.definitionCN: 测试；只拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Taste began with touching and testing, then settled on the tongue.
normalIntro.cn: taste 从触摸与检验开始，最后落在舌头上。

normal.en: She tasted the soup and found it salty.
normal.cn: 她尝了汤，觉得有点咸。

normal.en: The soup has a strong taste of garlic.
normal.cn: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。

normal.en: Her taste in music is very wide.
normal.cn: 她在音乐上的品味很广。

normal.en: He had a taste of success at nineteen.
normal.cn: 他十九岁时初尝成功。

normal.en: That joke was in poor taste.
normal.cn: 那个玩笑不得体。

abstract.en: Tasting is testing with the tongue.
abstract.cn: 品尝就是用舌头检验。

abstract.en: Style is flavour judged by the mind.
abstract.cn: 品味是头脑评判的风味。

abstract.en: A small taste can teach a whole life.
abstract.cn: 一小口滋味能教会整个人生。

examples.en: She tasted the soup and found it a little salty.
examples.cn: 她尝了一口汤，觉得有点咸。

examples.en: The soup has a strong taste of garlic.
examples.cn: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。

examples.en: Her taste in music is very wide.
examples.cn: 她在音乐上的品味很广。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「忒斯特」——舌尖「忒」地碰到汤，立刻判断出滋味，就是品尝。

root: 拉丁语 taxare（触击、评判）经古法语 taster（触摸、试验）进入英语，由「检验」转为「品尝」。

sensesIntro.en: Taste moves from testing by touch to flavour on the tongue, then to judgment and brief experience.
sensesIntro.cn: taste 从触摸检验，到舌尖滋味，再到判断力与短暂体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tongue meeting the edge of a spoon.
core.cn: 核心意象：舌尖碰到勺子的边缘。

branches.en: Flavour is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 滋味是日常义项。

branches.en: Tasting is the testing act.
branches.cn: 品尝是检验的动作。

branches.en: Judgment grows from testing.
branches.cn: 鉴赏力从检验中长出。

branches.en: A taste is a small sample of life.
branches.cn: 体验是人生的一小口。

branches.en: Both mean taking a sample.
branches.cn: 两者都表示取一点样本。

intro.en: Taste builds -y, -ful, and -less adjectives.
intro.cn: taste 构成 -y、-ful、-less 三个形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin taxare, to touch and judge, underlies taste through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 taxare（触击评判）经古法语构成 taste 的词源。

definition_en: money that people must pay to the government, or to make someone pay or work hard
core_image: 账本上一行被划走的分量
scene: 市里提高了停车税，车主们纷纷抱怨。The city raised the tax on parking, and drivers complained.
sceneCN: 这里 tax 是「税」（第 1 个义项）；句意：市里提高了停车税，车主们纷纷抱怨。

senses.title: Money paid to the state
senses.definition: money that people or businesses must pay to the government
senses.definitionCN: 个人或企业必须向政府缴纳的钱
senses.example: The city raised the tax on parking.
senses.exampleCN: 市里提高了停车税。
senses.why: The root meant to assess and rate a value, and the assessed sum became the tax.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为评估、核定价值，被核定出的那一笔钱就成了税。

senses.title: To impose a tax
senses.definition: to make someone pay a tax on something
senses.definitionCN: 要求某人为某物缴税
senses.example: The government taxed tobacco heavily.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对烟草课以重税。
senses.why: Assessing a value led to the act of charging it.
senses.whyCN: 核定价值这一动作，发展成实际征收。

senses.title: To put a strain on someone
senses.definition: to make heavy demands on someone's strength or patience
senses.definitionCN: 对某人的体力或耐心提出很高要求
senses.example: The long journey taxed his patience.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的旅程考验了他的耐心。
senses.why: A tax takes a share of what you have, just as strain takes a share of your strength.
senses.whyCN: 税拿走你的一部分钱财，正如负担拿走你的一部分力气。

intro.en: Tax goes back to a Latin verb meaning to assess or appraise.
intro.cn: tax 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「评估、核定」的动词。

items.en: Taxare meant to assess and appraise.
items.cn: taxare 意为评估、核定。

items.en: Taxa meant an assessed charge.
items.cn: taxa 意为核定出的费用。

items.en: Taxer meant to charge or blame.
items.cn: taxer 意为征收或指责。

items.en: Tax meant a sum demanded by a ruler.
items.cn: tax 指统治者要求缴纳的款项。

items.en: Tax extended to strain and to blame.
items.cn: tax 扩展到「使负累」与「指责」。

note.en: Tax is compared with look-alike words and with words for charges and burdens.
note.cn: 把 tax 与形近词以及表示费用与负担的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tax is a share assessed and taken from what you own.
normalIntro.cn: tax 是从你的所得中被核定并取走的一份。

normal.en: The city raised the tax on parking.
normal.cn: 市里提高了停车税。

normal.en: The government taxed tobacco heavily.
normal.cn: 政府对烟草课以重税。

normal.en: The long journey taxed his patience.
normal.cn: 漫长旅程考验了他的耐心。

normal.en: He filed his tax return in April.
normal.cn: 他在四月提交了纳税申报。

normal.en: Small shops often struggle with high taxes.
normal.cn: 小店常被高税负拖累。

abstract.en: A tax is a measured slice taken away.
abstract.cn: 税是被量好切走的一片。

abstract.en: To be taxed is to lend strength to a purpose.
abstract.cn: 被征税就是把力气借给某个目的。

abstract.en: Even patience can be taxed.
abstract.cn: 连耐心也会被课税。

examples.en: The city raised the tax on parking, and drivers complained.
examples.cn: 市里提高了停车税，车主们纷纷抱怨。

examples.en: The government taxed tobacco heavily.
examples.cn: 政府对烟草课以重税。

examples.en: The long journey taxed his patience.
examples.cn: 漫长的旅程考验了他的耐心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踏克斯」——每走一步都要「踏」出一份钱，就是交税。

root: 拉丁语 taxare（评估、核定）经中世纪拉丁语 taxa 与古法语 taxer 进入英语，由「核定的钱」转为「税」。

sensesIntro.en: Tax starts as an assessed sum, becomes the act of charging it, then any heavy demand.
sensesIntro.cn: tax 从核定的一笔钱，变成征收动作，再到任何沉重的要求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a measured share cut from a pile.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一堆里量出的一份被切走。

branches.en: The payment is the main sense.
branches.cn: 税款是主要义项。

branches.en: Charging it is the verb sense.
branches.cn: 征收是动词义。

branches.en: Strain takes strength like tax takes money.
branches.cn: 负担取走力气，如同税收取走钱财。

branches.en: Sum and charge are one system.
branches.cn: 款项与征收是一套制度。

branches.en: Patience can be charged too.
branches.cn: 耐心也能被课税。

intro.en: Tax builds taxation, taxable, and taxpayer.
intro.cn: tax 构成 taxation、taxable、taxpayer。

latinIntro.en: Latin taxare, to assess, is the direct source of the tax family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 taxare（评估）是 tax 词族的直接来源。

definition_en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere, or to move slowly on the ground
core_image: 街边一辆亮着顶灯的黄色小车
scene: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.
sceneCN: 这里 taxi 是「出租汽车」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。

senses.title: A car you pay to ride in
senses.definition: a car with a driver who takes you where you want for a fare
senses.definitionCN: 由司机驾驶、按里程收费送你到目的地的车
senses.example: He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。
senses.why: The name came from the fare meter fixed inside the car.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字来自装在车里的计价器。

senses.title: To move slowly on the ground
senses.definition: to move an aircraft slowly along the ground before or after flight
senses.definitionCN: 飞机起飞前或降落后在地面缓慢移动
senses.example: The plane taxied slowly to the runway.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机缓缓滑向跑道。
senses.why: A taxi rolls at low speed on the ground, much like a taxi car creeping through traffic.
senses.whyCN: 飞机在地面低速滚动，很像出租车在车流中缓慢挪动。

intro.en: Taxi is a shortened form of taxicab, named after the fare meter.
intro.cn: taxi 是 taxicab 的缩写，名字来自计价器。

items.en: Taxis meant order, and metron meant measure.
items.cn: taxis 意为次序，metron 意为度量。

items.en: Taximètre named a device that measured fares.
items.cn: taximètre 指测量车费的装置。

items.en: Taximeter entered English as the fare meter.
items.cn: taximeter 进入英语，指计价器。

items.en: Taxicab named the car that carried such a meter.
items.cn: taxicab 指装有计价器的车。

items.en: Taxi became the everyday short form.
items.cn: taxi 成为日常的简短说法。

note.en: Taxi is compared with look-alike words and with words for hired cars.
note.cn: 把 taxi 与形近词以及表示出租车辆的词作对比。

entries.definition: a vehicle going back and forth
the money paid for a ride

normalIntro.en: Taxi carries a meter, and the meter gave the car its name.
normalIntro.cn: taxi 车上带着计价器，计价器给了这辆车名字。

normal.en: He waved down a taxi.
normal.cn: 他招手叫了一辆出租车。

normal.en: The plane taxied slowly to the runway.
normal.cn: 飞机缓缓滑向跑道。

normal.en: The taxi driver knew every short cut.
normal.cn: 出租车司机熟悉每条近路。

normal.en: We waited at the taxi rank for ten minutes.
normal.cn: 我们在出租车候车点等了十分钟。

normal.en: The fare on the meter was fair.
normal.cn: 计价器上的车费很公道。

abstract.en: A meter that measures coins named a whole vehicle.
abstract.cn: 一个量钱的表，命名了一整辆车。

abstract.en: Both car and plane creep at the start of a journey.
abstract.cn: 车与飞机在旅程开始时都缓缓挪动。

abstract.en: A short name can travel far.
abstract.cn: 简短的名字能走得很远。

examples.en: He waved down a taxi and hurried to the airport.
examples.cn: 他招手叫了一辆出租车，赶去机场。

examples.en: The plane taxied slowly to the runway.
examples.cn: 飞机缓缓滑向跑道。

examples.en: The taxi driver knew every short cut.
examples.cn: 出租车司机熟悉每条近路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他可惜」——赶时间的人「他可惜」没早点叫车，只好拦下一辆出租。

root: 由希腊语 taxis（次序）与 metron（度量）构成法语 taximètre（计价器），再缩略为 taxicab 与 taxi。

sensesIntro.en: Taxi names the metered car first, then borrows the slow ground roll of an aircraft.
sensesIntro.cn: taxi 先指装表的车，再借指飞机在地面的低速滑行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small car with a glowing roof sign.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆车顶亮着灯的小车。

branches.en: The metered car is the main sense.
branches.cn: 装表的车是主要义项。

branches.en: An aircraft rolls like a car in traffic.
branches.cn: 飞机像车流中的车一样挪动。

branches.en: Both move slowly at the start.
branches.cn: 两者在起步时都很慢。

branches.en: The meter explains the name.
branches.cn: 计价器解释了名字的来源。

branches.en: Ground travel is the shared idea.
branches.cn: 地面移动是共同点。

intro.en: Taxi appears in compounds such as taxicab and taximeter.
intro.cn: taxi 出现在 taxicab、taximeter 等复合词中。

latinIntro.en: Taxi goes back to Greek roots through French, not to Latin.
latinIntro.cn: taxi 经法语上溯希腊语词根，而非拉丁语。

definition_en: a hot drink made from dried leaves, the leaves themselves, or an afternoon meal
core_image: 白瓷杯里浮着几片舒展的茶叶
scene: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
sceneCN: 这里 tea 是「茶」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她给客人倒了一杯热茶。

senses.title: A hot drink from leaves
senses.definition: a hot drink made by pouring water over dried leaves
senses.definitionCN: 用热水冲泡干叶制成的热饮
senses.example: She poured a cup of hot tea for her guest.
senses.exampleCN: 她给客人倒了一杯热茶。
senses.why: The drink is the first meaning the word carried into English.
senses.whyCN: 这个词进入英语时，最先指的就是这种饮料。

senses.title: The dried leaves
senses.definition: the dried leaves used to make the drink
senses.definitionCN: 用来冲泡饮料的干叶
senses.example: This tea comes from the hills in the south.
senses.exampleCN: 这种茶叶来自南方的丘陵。
senses.why: The material took the name of the drink it makes.

definition_en: to help someone learn something by showing or explaining it

senses.title: To help someone learn
senses.definition: to show or explain something so that another person learns it

senses.example: She teaches the village children to read and write.
senses.exampleCN: 她教村里的孩子读书写字。

senses.title: A drop of salty liquid from the eye
senses.definition: a drop of salty liquid that flows from the eye, usually because of strong emotion
senses.definitionCN: 从眼睛流出的一滴咸味液体，通常由强烈情绪引起
senses.example: A single tear rolled down her cheek during the farewell scene.
senses.exampleCN: 告别那一幕里，一滴泪从她的脸颊滑落。
senses.why: The oldest layer of the word is pure image: water rising from the eye when feeling overflows.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的层面就是画面本身：情绪满溢时，水从眼角涌出来。

senses.title: To pull paper or cloth apart with force
senses.definition: to pull paper, cloth, or similar material apart quickly and with force
senses.definitionCN: 用力快速地把纸、布等材料分开或弄破
senses.example: He tore the letter into pieces and threw them away.
senses.exampleCN: 他把信撕成碎片扔掉了。
senses.why: The verb comes from a different ancient root meaning to split or flay, so the core is force separating one thing into parts.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自另一个古老词根，本义是劈开、剥开，核心是用力把一个整体分开。

senses.title: To injure a muscle or ligament by stretching it too far
senses.definition: to injure a muscle or ligament by stretching or pulling it too violently
senses.definitionCN: 因过度拉扯而使肌肉或韧带受伤
senses.example: The sprinter tore a muscle in his right leg during the race.
senses.exampleCN: 短跑运动员比赛中右腿肌肉拉伤了。
senses.why: Body tissue is imagined as fabric: pull it too hard and it rips, exactly like cloth.
senses.whyCN: 身体组织被想象成布料：拉得太猛就会撕裂，正如撕布一样。

senses.title: To remove something quickly and roughly
senses.definition: to remove or detach something quickly and roughly, often off a surface or from its place
senses.definitionCN: 迅速而用力地把某物从表面或原处扯下、摘下
senses.example: She tore the poster off the wall and crumpled it.

senses.why: The same separating force as sense 02 is applied to objects fixed in place: rip it free.

senses.title: To be torn between two choices

intro.en: Tear is a doublet story: the noun and the verb look identical but come from two different ancient roots that met again in Old English.
intro.cn: tear 是一个「同形异源」的故事：名词与动词拼写相同，却来自两个不同的古老词根，在古英语中再次相遇。

items.en: The noun is generally traced to the reconstructed root *dakru-, the same ancient word that gave Greek dakry and Latin lacrima, all meaning 'tear'.
items.cn: 名词一般认为可追溯到重构词根 *dakru-，与希腊语 dakry、拉丁语 lacrima 同源，均表示「眼泪」。

items.en: In prehistoric Germanic, *dakru- underwent the regular sound shift and became *tahr-, inherited directly by Old English.
items.cn: 在史前日耳曼语中，*dakru- 经历了规律的音变，变为 *tahr-，被古英语直接继承。

items.en: Old English had the noun tear (tēar, 'tear drop') and, from a separate root *der- meaning 'to split or flay', the strong verb teran 'to tear'.
items.cn: 古英语中既有名词 tēar（泪滴），又有来自另一个词根 *der-（意为劈开、剥皮）的强变化动词 teran（撕）。

items.en: Middle English kept both words, spelled teere and teren, and the two spellings gradually converged into one modern form.
items.cn: 中古英语保留了这两个词，拼作 teere 和 teren，两种拼写逐渐合流为现代的同一形式。

items.en: Modern English keeps the homographs apart in speech: the noun is pronounced with /ɪə/, the verb with /eə/, so listeners always know which root is meant.
items.cn: 现代英语在口语中以读音区分同形词：名词读 /ɪə/，动词读 /eə/，听者总能分辨指的是哪个来源。

note.en: Watch the two pronunciations, and separate the noun family (drops of water) from the verb family (ripping force).
note.cn: 注意两种读音，把「水滴家族」（名词）与「撕扯家族」（动词）分开理解。

normal.en: Noun tear rhymes with 'ear': tears come from near the ears of the face, the eyes.
normal.cn: 名词 tear 与 ear 押韵：泪水和耳朵一样都长在脸上，联想「脸上有 ear 就有 tear」。

normal.en: Verb tear rhymes with 'air': rip a page off and let it fly into the air.
normal.cn: 动词 tear 与 air 押韵：把一页纸撕下来，让它飞进空气里。

normal.en: Past forms run tore → torn: the paper was torn apart, the team was torn apart.
normal.cn: 过去式 tore、过去分词 torn：纸被 torn apart，家庭也可能被 torn apart。

normal.en: The family set is tearful, teary, teardrop, tearless: tear + -ful / -y / drop / -less.
normal.cn: 词族一串记：tearful（含泪的）、teary（泪汪汪的）、teardrop（泪珠）、tearless（无泪的）。

normal.en: burst into tears and in tears are the fixed collocations for starting to cry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配记两头：burst into tears（突然大哭）、in tears（含着泪）。

definition_en: a device for speaking to someone far away, or to call someone using it
core_image: 桌上黑色话筒被拿起来
scene: 他抓起电话，拨通了家里的号码。He picked up the telephone and dialled home.
sceneCN: 这里 telephone 是「电话、电话机」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他抓起电话，拨通了家里的号码。

senses.title: A device for distant speech
senses.definition: a device that carries speech between distant places
senses.definitionCN: 把说话声传到远方的装置
senses.example: He picked up the telephone and dialled home.
senses.exampleCN: 他抓起电话，拨通了家里的号码。
senses.why: The Greek parts mean far and voice, which is exactly what the device does.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语两部分意为「远」与「声音」，正是这台装置所做的事。

senses.title: To call someone
senses.definition: to speak to someone by using a telephone
senses.definitionCN: 通过电话与某人说话
senses.example: She telephoned the office to explain the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 她打电话到办公室解释延误。

intro.en: Telephone is built from Greek words for far and voice.
intro.cn: telephone 由希腊语中「远」与「声音」两个词构成。

items.en: Tele meant far away.

note.en: Telephone is compared with look-alike forms and with words for calling.
note.cn: 把 telephone 与形近形式以及表示通话的词作对比。

root: 希腊语 tele（远）加 phone（声音）构成，经法语 téléphone 进入英语，字面即「远处的声音」。

sensesIntro.en: Telephone names the device first and the act of calling second.

branches.en: Calling is using the far voice.

definition_en: the system of sending pictures and sound, the device that receives them, or the industry

senses.title: The broadcasting system
senses.definition: the system that sends moving pictures and sound to homes
senses.definitionCN: 把活动画面与声音送到家庭的系统
senses.example: The family sat together watching the match on television.
senses.exampleCN: 一家人围坐在一起看电视里的球赛。
senses.why: The Greek and Latin parts mean far and sight, and the system carries sight far.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语与拉丁语两部分意为「远」与「视觉」，这套系统正是把视觉送到远处。

senses.title: The receiving set

senses.title: The industry

senses.why: The medium grew into an industry with its own workers.
